notes.title: Join the Blood Crossroad Community: Playtest Announcement and Updates!
notes.notes:
Welcome everyone to the BLOOD CROSSROAD community. 
We're thrilled to see your interest in William's adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923968/267d0a8dc22959cb2abefab1fae8fa9341beef56.gif[/img]

Currently, we're conducting playtests. Given the positive feedback from early players, 
we are planning to release the demo very soon.

In the coming days, we'll grant access to the playtest for 100 players. 
Then, during the weekend, another 100 will gain entry.
If you'd like to participate in the playtest, please sign up for it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923968/dd7b637e976e8134124f0ec01c6c341604dc5b2c.gif[/img]

The playtest has been localized in Portuguese, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, 
Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Indonesian. 
We hope this makes the title more accessible!

Also, If you want to stream the gameplay and/or create web content about it, feel free to do so!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923968/79861e5f22912a5edd6212c5f49c0c7bfb934af5.gif[/img]

We'll be posting new materials on this page, so if you don't want to miss updates, 
don't forget to follow the Blood Crossroad page on Steam and add the title to your wishlist! 
Suggest our game to your friends if they might be interested! It would help us a lot!

We hope that our titles provide you with a great gaming experience...
